notes.title: New version 9.0
notes.notes:
We are pleased to present a major update to Draw Rider v9.0. We have not updated the PC version of the game for a long time, the problem was that all the code had to be rewritten in several places. Now Draw Rider on mobile devices and a computer is one game. From now on, game updates will be released simultaneously on all platforms!

A lot has changed since the last update in the game. The career mode has been completely redone. Now you are waiting for 24 championships in which you are waiting for more than 320 levels! New character and bike customization with tons of stuff! New online test mode. New menu design and subscription to your favorite authors online!

In the new update you will find many new cards that you can get for passing the championships and experience. New items in the editor (mines, portals, moving way bonuses). Also in the editor added a tool for moving and rotating objects. Now in the game you can try cards before buying, as well as gain experience and coins from chests. Also, you will find the Russian language and many small changes and corrections that did not fit into the description =)
